summary: Lima is a world-class culinary destination and Peru's vibrant capital, perched on the Pacific coast with stunning colonial architecture and modern gastronomy. From exploring the historic old town's ornate plazas to savoring cutting-edge fusion cuisine, Lima seamlessly blends pre-Hispanic heritage with contemporary culture. The city offers exceptional photography opportunities, world-renowned restaurants, and close proximity to the Sacred Valley and Machu Picchu.

restaurants.name: Central
restaurants.description: Consistently ranked among the world's best restaurants, Central offers an innovative tasting menu that tells the story of Peru's biodiversity through 20+ courses.
restaurants.mustTry: Sea urchin and Amazonian fruits tasting sequence

restaurants.name: Maido
restaurants.description: A Nikkei (Japanese-Peruvian fusion) masterpiece with artful presentations and impeccable technique, ranked among the world's top 50 restaurants.
restaurants.mustTry: Miso black cod and Amazonian fish nigiri

restaurants.name: Astrid y Gastón
restaurants.description: Pioneering chef Gastón Acurio's elegant restaurant in a restored mansion, celebrating Peruvian ingredients with refined technique and warm hospitality.
restaurants.mustTry: Ceviche trio and duck confit with purple potato puree

restaurants.name: El Señorío de Sulco
restaurants.description: A charming colonial house restaurant serving traditional Peruvian cuisine with excellent ceviche, causa, and regional specialties in an intimate setting.
restaurants.mustTry: Ceviche mixto and Papa a la Huancaína

restaurants.name: La Cevichería
restaurants.description: Casual, lively spot in Miraflores famous for fresh ceviche prepared right before your eyes with creative flavor combinations and excellent pisco cocktails.
restaurants.mustTry: Ceviche clásico and tiradito with ají amarillo

restaurants.name: Panchita
restaurants.description: An iconic family-run cevichería in the Surquillo market serving no-frills, incredibly fresh ceviche and seafood at unbeatable prices.

restaurants.name: Isolina Taberna
restaurants.description: Cozy traditional restaurant in Miraflores offering classic Peruvian dishes including excellent causa, anticuchos, and regional soups with authentic flavors.
restaurants.mustTry: Causa limeña and anticuchos de corazón

restaurants.name: Café Café
restaurants.description: Popular local café in central Lima serving excellent coffee, fresh pastries, sandwiches, and light meals perfect for breakfast or lunch.
restaurants.mustTry: Avena smoothie and sándwich de pollo

restaurants.name: Pescado Cebichería
restaurants.description: Seafood-focused restaurant near the coast offering daily-fresh fish preparations, excellent ceviches, and traditional coastal Peruvian cuisine.
restaurants.mustTry: Ceviche de pez blanco and arroz con mariscos

restaurants.name: Punto Azul
restaurants.description: Hidden gem in the Callao fish market serving ultra-fresh ceviche and seafood directly from the docks at incredibly low prices.
restaurants.mustTry: Ceviche del día and fried fish fillets

restaurants.name: Rafael Restaurant
restaurants.description: Contemporary Peruvian cuisine in an elegant Miraflores setting, focusing on seasonal ingredients and innovative presentations with impeccable service.
restaurants.mustTry: Black mussels and lima bean risotto

restaurants.name: Chez Wong
restaurants.description: Family-run Chinese-Peruvian (Chifa) restaurant serving excellent tallarín saltado and fusion dishes that reflect Lima's multicultural heritage.

activities.name: Machu Picchu Day Tour
activities.description: Take a train or fly to Aguas Calientes and hike to the iconic Incan citadel, one of the world's most important archaeological sites with breathtaking mountain views.

activities.name: Sacred Valley Tour
activities.description: Explore traditional Quechua communities, terraced agricultural sites, and local markets in the lush Andean valley, including stops at Ollantaytambo and Pisac ruins.

activities.name: Lima Historic Center Walking Tour
activities.description: Stroll through UNESCO-listed colonial architecture including the Plaza de Armas, Cathedral, and San Francisco Monastery with its catacombs containing thousands of remains.

activities.name: Miraflores Cliffside Walk
activities.description: Scenic coastal walk along dramatic Pacific cliffs with parks, viewpoints, restaurants, and shops, perfect for sunset viewing and people-watching.

activities.name: Gold Museum (Museo del Oro)
activities.description: Impressive collection of pre-Columbian gold artifacts, textiles, and weapons spanning thousands of years of Peruvian civilization.

activities.name: Larco Museum
activities.description: World-class private museum in a colonial mansion featuring pre-Hispanic art, erotic ceramics, and contemporary works spanning 5,000 years of Peruvian culture.

activities.name: Barranco District Exploration
activities.description: Bohemian neighborhood with colorful colonial houses, street art, boutique galleries, craft breweries, live music venues, and the famous Puente de Suspiros bridge.

activities.name: Peru's Gastronomic Workshop
activities.description: Hands-on cooking class learning to prepare traditional Peruvian dishes like ceviche and causa from expert chefs, including market tour and tasting.

activities.name: Callao Naval Museum
activities.description: Maritime museum showcasing Peru's naval history and the famous ship La María Isabel, located in the historic port city of Callao.

activities.name: Chicken Bus Food Tour
activities.description: Authentic street food tour sampling ceviche, anticuchos, picarones, and other local specialties at neighborhood markets and street stalls with a local guide.

activities.name: Surfing at Chicama or Cerro Azul
activities.description: Experience world-class Pacific wave breaks with lessons available for all levels at Lima's nearby beach breaks south of the city.

activities.name: Lima Nightlife and Pisco Tasting
activities.description: Experience Peru's famous pisco brandy at top distilleries and bars, followed by live music and dancing at clubs in Miraflores or Barranco.

spots.name: Plaza de Armas (Historic Center)
spots.description: Stunning colonial plaza ringed by the Cathedral and Archbishop's Palace with ornate architecture, perfect for golden hour light and people interaction.

spots.name: San Francisco Monastery
spots.description: Magnificent Baroque church with intricate wooden ceilings and catacombs, offering dramatic architectural details in moody interior lighting.

spots.name: Miraflores Cliffs at Sunset
spots.description: Dramatic Pacific coastline with golden light hitting cliff faces and creating dynamic sky colors, with parks and viewpoints for positioning.

spots.name: Barranco Painted Houses
spots.description: Colorful colonial architecture in this bohemian district with vibrant building facades, street art, and local characters for lively street photography.

spots.name: Puente de Suspiros (Barranco)
spots.description: Iconic wrought-iron suspension bridge over a small ravine, beautifully lit in late afternoon with romantic atmosphere and surrounding colonial charm.

spots.name: Lima Waterfront at Chorrillos
spots.description: Seaside promenade with fishermen, boats, and evening light reflecting off the Pacific, offering street and landscape photography opportunities.

spots.name: Museum of Art (Interior Galleries)
spots.description: World-class art museum with pre-Hispanic artifacts beautifully displayed in controlled lighting, ideal for detailed macro and museum photography.

spots.name: Callao Port and Fortress
spots.description: Historic naval fortress with colonial stone walls, overlooking working harbor with ships and industrial elements, atmospheric at dawn or dusk.

spots.name: Kennedy Park (Miraflores)
spots.description: Hilltop park with 360-degree city views, ocean vistas, and local life, excellent for wide landscape shots and sunset cityscape photography.

spots.name: Surquillo Market at Dawn
spots.description: Bustling traditional fish and produce market with vibrant colors, local vendors, and authentic daily life scenes perfect for candid street photography.

lensRecommendations: 16-35mm wide-angle for architectural sweeps and landscape vistas of Lima's coastline and colonial plazas
50mm prime for street photography and intimate portraits in markets and neighborhoods
70-200mm telephoto for compressed cityscapes, distant coastal features, and detailed architectural elements
photography.goldenHourNotes: Lima's golden hour is exceptionally long due to its coastal latitude, typically lasting 60-90 minutes before and after sunset. The Miraflores cliffs reflect warm light beautifully during this period, while colonial architecture in the historic center gains dramatic shadows. Early morning offers soft light on the Pacific and golden tones on historic buildings before marine layer develops.

weather.seasonality: Lima's climate is arid and temperate year-round due to the cold Humboldt Current. Summer (December-March) brings warmth and occasional light rain, while winter (June-August) is cool and often overcast with marine layer fog. Spring and autumn offer the most pleasant conditions with mild temperatures and clear skies.
weather.summary: Lima enjoys a mild, coastal desert climate with virtually no rainfall and temperatures ranging from 17-27°C. The city rarely experiences extreme weather, making it accessible year-round, though May-September offers clearer skies and September-November provides the warmest, sunniest conditions.

hotels.name: Selina Lima Plaza Mayor
hotels.description: Trendy hostel and co-working space in a restored colonial building in the historic center with shared and private rooms, rooftop bar, and vibrant social atmosphere.

hotels.name: Belmond Miraflores Park
hotels.description: Elegant boutique hotel perched on the Miraflores cliffs with ocean views, excellent restaurant, spa, and direct access to coastal parks and galleries.

hotels.name: Palacio Nazarenas
hotels.description: Ultra-luxury beachfront resort with personalized service, world-class dining, spa facilities, and stunning Pacific Ocean views from every suite.
